defense.description: Aggressive, pressure-oriented unit under Nowinsky (“get after the quarterback”); bear-front and blitz wrinkles discussed in spring coverage. A single exclusive published base-front label for 2026 was Not listed.

offense.description: Balanced, personnel-driven, complementary offense under Eck / Schleusner (creative / red-zone emphasis in prior reporting). Entering 2026, with starter Jack Layne out for the season, the staff publicly committed to a multi-quarterback approach (Laubstein, Moga, Faʻavae) rather than a rigid named system brand (Albuquerque Journal / Daily Lobo).
